messages:
release-manager: Heads up — staging promotion blocked, CI failing on the integration-matrix job. Canary is stuck.
deploy-bot: promotion blocked: staged-job-4321 failed (exit 1) — https://ci.company/build/4321 :x:
jamal: logs point to concurrency flakes in tests/integration/test_session_pool.py when run with 12 workers
maria: saw that too earlier, seems correlated with DB connection pool exhaustion after test hammering
sre-oncall: I can repro locally, creating a run with --max-workers=4 to confirm impact
qa-raz: failing assertion snippet from the build log:
```
E       AssertionError: expected 1 but got 0
tests/integration/test_session_pool.py:78
```
release-manager: timeline check — change window opens at 16:00 (in ~2 hrs). Do we pin image to last-green or rollback the feature branch?
linh: leaning to pin the backend image to r-2026-03-17 (sha: abc123) and re-run canary. Rollback risky because of the queued db migration in the branch.
jamal: pinning is fine, but we need to watch artifact-store semantics — older artifacts sometimes 404 if TTL expired on the CDN edge
maria: artifact-store returned 500 earlier on GET /blobs/abc123, looked transient; I'm retrying upload from staging artifacts now
deploy-bot: artifact upload attempt 1 failed for abc123 (502 gateway). Retrying queued.
maria: retry 2 succeeded, verified size 42.1MB, checksum sha256:fa3b... now available
deploy-bot: promotion reattempt queued; canary job created: https://ci.company/build/4330
sre-oncall: spinning a watch on DB connection metrics and p95 latency for the canary run; will abort if p95 > 200ms for more than 3 mins
qa-raz: I'll run the smoke suite manually against canary endpoint once the build finishes
release-manager: decision checklist: pin image -> re-run canary -> if green, cut; if flakey, rollback commit. Jamal + Maria own the pin + artifact retry; Raz smoke; Linh keep migration freeze
product-hannah: FYI we've pulled the tiny UI tweak from this cut to reduce blast radius
deploy-bot: canary run finished: 4330 — status: green :white_check_mark: https://ci.company/build/4330
qa-raz: manual smoke pass ✅ all core flows ok (login, billing, inference route)
sre-oncall: DB p95 stayed at 72ms during run, no connection leaks observed
release-manager: sounds good. Cutting release at 16:05. Postmortem note: add integration test throttling in CI and a canary job with lower concurrency by default.
deploy-bot: promotion successful — release queued for 2026-03-20T16:05Z :tada:
file_notes: CI concurrency flake led to artifact retry and image pin; canary re-run green, release scheduled. Contains bot links and code snippet.
